subject.descriptionZh: 地质年代、地貌、构造地质及地球表层过程。
subject.descriptionJa: 地質年代、地形、構造地質、地球表層過程。
subject.descriptionEn: Geochronology, geomorphology, structural geology, and Earth-surface processes.

Earth-Science.Geochronology.subject: Earth-Science
Earth-Science.Geochronology.descriptionZh: 利用放射性核素等方法测定地质事件与地貌的年代。
Earth-Science.Geochronology.descriptionJa: 放射性核種などを用いて地質現象や地形の年代を求める分野。
Earth-Science.Geochronology.descriptionEn: Dating geological events and landforms, including radiometric methods.

Earth-Science.Periglacial-Geomorphology.subject: Earth-Science
Earth-Science.Periglacial-Geomorphology.descriptionZh: 永久冻土、冻融作用及其形成的地貌。
Earth-Science.Periglacial-Geomorphology.descriptionJa: 永久凍土、凍結融解作用、それらがつくる地形。
Earth-Science.Periglacial-Geomorphology.descriptionEn: Permafrost, freeze-thaw processes, and associated landforms.

Earth-Science.Fluvial-Geomorphology.subject: Earth-Science
Earth-Science.Fluvial-Geomorphology.descriptionZh: 河流侵蚀、堆积、下切与阶地形成。
Earth-Science.Fluvial-Geomorphology.descriptionJa: 河川の侵食、堆積、下刻、段丘形成。
Earth-Science.Fluvial-Geomorphology.descriptionEn: River erosion, deposition, incision, and terrace formation.

Earth-Science.Structural-Geology.subject: Earth-Science
Earth-Science.Structural-Geology.descriptionZh: 断层、褶皱、地壳变形及其地貌证据。
Earth-Science.Structural-Geology.descriptionJa: 断層、褶曲、地殻変形とその地形的証拠。
Earth-Science.Structural-Geology.descriptionEn: Faults, folds, crustal deformation, and their geomorphic evidence.
